descriptions.w3d_turns_publish_team_worm_count: Counts state-one worms belonging to a team and publishes WormCount.
descriptions.w3d_turns_publish_worm_count: Counts worms on included teams and stores and publishes the total.
descriptions.w3d_turns_publish_team_count: Refreshes per-team worm counts and publishes the number of nonempty teams.
descriptions.w3d_turns_next_team: Chooses the next included team with eligible worms or uses alliance selection.
descriptions.w3d_turns_team_has_eligible: Tests whether a team contains a state-one worm eligible for a turn.
descriptions.w3d_turns_publish_alliance_count: Counts nonempty alliance lists and publishes AllianceCount.
descriptions.w3d_turns_create_actor_for_entity: Creates an actor for an entity, registers it, and stores its handle.
descriptions.w3d_turns_get_active_actor: Looks up ActiveWormIndex and returns its stored actor handle when in range.
